text: The Lyse group, headquartered in Stavanger, is wholly owned by 15 municipalities; the Brønnøysund Register files Lyse AS under sector code 1520, municipally owned limited companies.
short: Lyse AS is wholly owned by 15 Norwegian municipalities.

source.name: Lyse: Om Lyse-konsernet
source.quote: Konsernet er heleid av 15 kommuner og vår verdiskaping går tilbake til fellesskapet.
